title: MiyooMini-Ports catalog
description: Port entries for the Miyoo Mini family (SigmaStar SSD202D).

name.description: Display name shown in the catalog and README.

category.description: Genre. Free-form, but reuse an existing one if it fits.

status.description: playable: runs well. experimental: runs but rough. prerelease: upstream author labels it pre-release. source only: no binary, user builds it.

assets.description: free: nothing to supply. owned: user supplies game data.

upstream.description: Link the /releases page (not a pinned version). Source-only ports with no releases link the repo root.

image.description: Optional stable screenshot URL. GitHub user-attachment URLs are permanent.

notes.description: Setup gotchas, device caveats, what to supply. Keep it short.
